name: icash_sender_private.november_room(text,boolean,timestamp with time zone)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_sender_private.november_room(p_sender text, p_cold boolean, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when p_sender in ('+16462959838','+18623812530','+17866727869','+16462494809','+15056019451','+15055072937','+15127791343','+16027722055','+14357242174','+17262035755','+17262060050','+17189714119','+16463796122','+13104615259') and p_cold then
  p_at is not null and extract(hour from p_at at time zone 'America/New_York')>=9
  and extract(hour from p_at at time zone 'America/New_York')<21
  and (select count(*)<200 and count(*) filter(where admitted_at>p_at-interval '1 hour')<20
    and count(*) filter(where admitted_at>p_at-interval '3 minutes')=0
   from icash_sender_private.uses where sender=p_sender and cold and admitted_at>p_at-interval '24 hours')
 else true end
$function$
